data.description:
## Description

**What**: Write migrate-story-pr-bases.sh — a one-time operator migration script that detects open story/* PRs targeting main, retargets them to the session branch, and re-triggers per-branch-review.yml to satisfy the new required check.

**Why**: When this epic ships, in-flight sprint sessions may have open story PRs targeting main. Without migration, these PRs cannot merge (the session→main PR is now the only path). The migration script automates retargeting so operators don't need to close and recreate PRs.

**Scope**:
- IN: New script plugins/dso/scripts/migrate-story-pr-bases.sh; detects open story/* PRs targeting main via `gh pr list --search 'base:main head:story/'`; PATCHes base to session_branch via gh API PATCH /pulls/{n}; issues `gh workflow run per-branch-review.yml --ref <head-branch>` to re-trigger required check; clears or invalidates cached review-status for migrated PRs; documents TrackerDefenseStore interaction; idempotent (safe to re-run); uses resolve-session-branch.sh for session branch discovery
- OUT: Creating or modifying open PRs (only retargeting existing story/* PRs targeting main)

## Done Definitions

- When this story is complete, migrate-story-pr-bases.sh detects open story/* PRs targeting main, PATCHes each PR's base to the session branch, and issues gh workflow run per-branch-review.yml for each retargeted PR
  ← Satisfies: "In-flight migration: migrate-story-pr-bases.sh detects and retargets open story/* PRs" (Operational Constraint)
- When this story is complete, the script is idempotent: re-running on already-migrated PRs produces no duplicate actions
  ← Satisfies: Operational Constraint (re-run safe)
- Unit tests written and passing for all new or modified logic

## Considerations

- [Reliability] Changing a PR base from main to session-branch via PATCH may invalidate the cached review (different merge-base → different diff hash) and may carry over DefenseStore entries keyed against the old base. Migration script must: (a) clear or invalidate any cached review-status for migrated PRs, (b) trigger a fresh per-branch-review run via gh workflow run, (c) document TrackerDefenseStore interaction so operators know defenses written under base=main are not valid against the new base.

## Escalation Policy

**Escalation policy**: Proceed unless a significant assumption is required to continue — one that could send the implementation in the wrong direction. Escalate only when genuinely blocked without a reasonable inference. Document all assumptions made without escalating.
data.title: As an operator deploying this epic, I can migrate in-flight story PRs that target main to target the session branch instead
